instruction: A candid outdoor full-body photograph captures a couple walking together on a sunny day. On the left, the blonde woman in the checkered dress (R2) walks forward, holding red roses in her right hand and looking at her partner. On the right, the man in the peach t-shirt (R1) walks beside her, looking back at her with a smile. They walk hand-in-hand along a paved path. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct sunlight casting shadows on the pavement, with green trees in the background.
elements: R2 carries red roses in her right hand while walking with R1
R1 walks beside R2 and smiles while looking back at her
R1 and R2 walk hand-in-hand together
paved outdoor path with green trees in bright sunlight
